"""Prepare an internal team template; run from the development project's tests folder."""
import copy
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile

PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))
from app_health_checker.application_config import reject_secrets


def make_template(source, app_ids):
    if not isinstance(source, dict) or not isinstance(source.get("applications"), dict):
        raise ValueError("Application settings missing")
    applications = copy.deepcopy(source["applications"])
    if set(applications) - set(app_ids):
        raise ValueError("Unknown application")
    for override in applications.values():
        if not isinstance(override, dict):
            raise ValueError("Invalid application settings")
        data = override.get("data", {})
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            raise ValueError("Invalid application data")
        # Each new profile will resolve its own approved SOAP resource.
        data.pop("soapui_project", None)
    result = {"applications": applications}
    reject_secrets(result)
    return result


def write_new(target, value):
    """Publish without replacing an existing template, even on concurrent runs."""
    temporary = None
    try:
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
            mode="w", encoding="utf-8", dir=target.parent,
            prefix=".team-", suffix=".tmp", delete=False,
        ) as handle:
            temporary = Path(handle.name)
            json.dump(value, handle, indent=2)
            handle.write("\n")
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
        if os.name == "nt":
            os.rename(temporary, target)
        else:
            os.link(temporary, target)
    finally:
        if temporary is not None:
            temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def main(project=PROJECT):
    source = project / "config" / "local_overrides.json"
    target = project / "setup" / "team-config.json"
    if target.exists():
        print("STOP: Team configuration already exists; nothing replaced.")
        return 1
    if not source.is_file() or not target.parent.is_dir():
        print("STOP: Source settings or setup folder missing.")
        return 1
    try:
        definitions = [json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
                       for p in (project / "config" / "applications").glob("*.json")]
        if not definitions:
            raise ValueError("Catalog missing")
        original = source.read_bytes()
        value = make_template(json.loads(original.decode("utf-8-sig")),
                              [app["app_id"] for app in definitions])
        write_new(target, value)
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError):
        print("STOP: Team configuration could not be prepared; no settings changed.")
        return 1
    print("TEAM CONFIG: CREATED; PERSONAL BROWSER / MAIL: EXCLUDED; SOAP PATH: EXCLUDED.")
    print("SOURCE SETTINGS: UNCHANGED; REVIEW: REQUIRED BEFORE TEAM USE.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
